title: Portals?
content: Does anyone else see portals in their mall world dreams? I see them constantly, but I've only ever been able to go through one once. When I did make it through, it was almost like I had stepped into a mirror. Everything was facing away from me, and it just felt off. They're usually behind doors, and for whatever reason there's always an elderly woman in the room the door to the portal is in, and no one is allowed to disturb her. A lot of my mallworld dreams have revolved around trying to get in that room and get to the portal. I'm excited I found this community.
